additional_test_convention: Completion means reaching the supplied month-end marker; a whole history and individual steps have separate endpoints. Markers order events, not days/hours/numerals in the manuscript.
causal_scope: Positive Horn consequences only; absent derivation is not negation. Normal mechanism applies only to declared normal episodes with water-driven float rise. Index motion is a separate history.
automatic_extra: A controller can trigger one local index step when both wheel rotation and a separately supplied advance-due flag hold; no daily rate or month completion derived.
source_context: Full parent10/13-15 rules out equal physical hour durations for the same source-hour kind; this is contextual, not a newly translated clause.
